name: Blues shuffle
label: SHUFFLE
source: Soundbrenner Blues shuffle (hat on the first and third of each triplet, snare 2 and 4, kick 1 and 3); Musicians Institute shuffle lesson (shuffle drops the middle of the triplet); The Drum Ninja (kick 1 and 3, snare 2 and 4); tempo a practice default

sources.title: Soundbrenner: blues shuffle
sources.shows: Hi-hat 1 - let 2 - let (middle triplet silent), snare 2 and 4, kick often 1 and 3

sources.title: Musicians Institute: shuffle
sources.shows: The shuffle is based on the 8th note triplet and eliminates the second partition

sources.title: The Drum Ninja: blues drums
sources.shows: Triplet pattern in 12/8, kick on one and three, snare on two and four
